idea-plugin.name: Maekom Code Tracker
idea-plugin.description:
Maekom Code Tracker is a 100% local, offline, read-only code and workflow analysis plugin for IntelliJ IDEA.

Built for post-hoc analysis of Spring Boot + GitLab repositories (single and multi-module) utilizing PostgreSQL (JPA/MyBatis), Redis, MongoDB, and external MSA/legacy APIs.

  • Two-phase on-demand Git commit & unified diff analysis (strictly read-only)
  • Work episode grouping & automatic Markdown (.md) context linking
  • Dual classification: Primary Architecture Layer + Related Tech Stack Tags
  • Smart code location pointers with direct editor navigation & standard Diff viewer
  • 5-layer local evidence engine for change rationale ("Why") & architecture check badges
